skills.name: opendocs
skills.description: Publish Markdown to shareable links and export PDF or DOCX with OpenDocs. Use when the user wants to publish, share, host or send a Markdown document, turn notes into a link, or get a PDF/Word version of Markdown. Works with the opendocs npm CLI or, without Node.js, the bundled scripts/opendocs.sh (curl + jq).
